_comment: Repo scope for session_closure_audit.py. Add a repo by adding one entry here — no code change needed. 'path' is the repo root (or the root that contains .claude/worktrees for BIMpossible-style setups); the script walks 'git worktree list' from there, so linked worktrees are discovered automatically and never need their own entry. Optional 'platform' (sys.platform prefix: win32 / linux / darwin) scopes an entry to one OS; '~' expands.
